page.overview:
What is Pollaxe?

The [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poleaxe pollaxe] (also poleaxe, pole-axe, pole axe, polax, and Hache (French meaning axe) is a European polearm that was widely used by medieval infantry.thumb|Pollaxe

The weapon is introduced and used by the Monk in Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero.

In Mortal Kombat X, Shinnok uses a Bone Pollaxe as a part of his Bone Shaper Variation.

Sub-Zero utilizes an Ice Pollaxe alongside two smaller Ice Battle Axes during gameplay. He specifically uses the large Ice Pollaxe during his Fatal Blow, during his Fatality called Ice-Cutioner and during his Frostbite Outro while utilizing the smaller battle axes for a majority of gameplay. Unlike the Ice Battle Axes, the Ice Pollaxe can not be customized through the Kustomization.
